cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(buildit LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 14)

file(GLOB BUILDIT_SOURCES src/**/*.cpp)

add_library(buildit STATIC ${BUILDIT_SOURCES})

file(CONFIGURE
  OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/gen/compiler_headers.h
  CONTENT [[
# pragma once
// This file is generated by CMake. Do not edit manually.
#define GEN_TEMPLATE_NAME "@PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR@/scratch/code_XXXXXX"
#define COMPILER_PATH "@CMAKE_C_COMPILER@"
#define CXX_COMPILER_PATH "@CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER@"
  ]]
)

target_include_directories(buildit PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

target_include_directories(buildit PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

option(BUILD_SAMPLES "Build sample applications" OFF)

if(BUILD_SAMPLES)
  file(GLOB SAMPLE_SOURCES samples/*.cpp)
  foreach(SAMPLE_SOURCE ${SAMPLE_SOURCES})
      get_filename_component(SAMPLE_NAME ${SAMPLE_SOURCE} NAME_WE)
      add_executable(${SAMPLE_NAME} ${SAMPLE_SOURCE})
      target_link_libraries(${SAMPLE_NAME} buildit)
  endforeach()
endif()
